mapper.select: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(created_at), #{now}) FROM outbox_events WHERE event_type = 'SHIPMENT_AUTO_CONFIRM' AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT id, aggregate_id AS shipmentId, attempts FROM outbox_events WHERE id = #{eventId} AND event_type = 'SHIPMENT_AUTO_CONFIRM'

SELECT id, event_type AS eventType, aggregate_type AS aggregateType, aggregate_id AS aggregateId, attempts, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.lastProductId')) AS UNSIGNED) AS lastProductId FROM outbox_events WHERE event_type IN ('SEARCH_PRODUCT_REFRESH', 'SEARCH_SHOP_REFRESH', 'SEARCH_BRAND_REFRESH', 'SEARCH_CATEGORY_REFRESH') AND status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (claim_until IS NULL OR claim_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET payload = JSON_SET(payload, '$.lastProductId', #{lastProductId}), next_attempt_at = NOW(), claim_token = NULL, claim_until = NULL WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND claim_token = #{token}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'DEAD' THEN 1 END) AS dead, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN created_at END), NOW()) AS oldestPendingSeconds FROM outbox_events WHERE event_type IN ('SEARCH_PRODUCT_REFRESH', 'SEARCH_SHOP_REFRESH', 'SEARCH_BRAND_REFRESH', 'SEARCH_CATEGORY_REFRESH') AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DEAD')
